meta.name: campaign-dashboard
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user says 'campaign status', 'show me campaigns', 'visualize campaigns', 'what's the state of campaigns', 'campaign dashboard', 'open campaign view', 'how are outreach campaigns doing visually', 'show campaign pipeline', 'show me the leads for [campaign]', or any variant indicating they want a visual browser-based campaign dashboard.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 可视化查看推广活动状态与线索
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要直观浏览推广活动进展和线索数据。
copy.tagline_en: Visually browse campaign status and leads.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a visual dashboard for campaign progress and leads.

howto.what: 装上后，当用户要求查看活动状态时，Claude会启动本地GTM-OS服务器，在浏览器打开活动仪表板，显示活动卡片、指标和状态筛选，并能深入查看单个活动的线索时间线和变体对比。
howto.when: 当用户说出“campaign status”、“show me campaigns”、“campaign dashboard”等关键词，或要求以可视化方式查看活动状态时触发。

say.note: 打开活动仪表板总览页面。
展示活动卡片、进度条和指标。
进入单个活动查看线索时间线和变体对比。

howto.what_en: When the user asks to view campaign status, Claude starts the local GTM-OS server and opens the campaign dashboard in the browser, showing campaign cards, metrics, status filters, and allows drilling into individual campaigns for per-lead timelines and variant comparison.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says 'campaign status', 'show me campaigns', 'campaign dashboard', or similar phrases indicating they want a visual campaign overview.

say_en.note: Displays campaign cards, progress, and metrics.
Goes to per-lead timeline and variant comparison.
